Subject: Unexpected provisional VAT withholding on Dec invoice + token counts seem off

Hi Connor,

Quick note — we received the December invoice (invoice #PROV-123) this morning and there's a new line item labelled 'Provisional VAT withholding (EU)'. That wasn't on our previous months and it increased the total due by ~€12.4k. We've attached the invoice and a short sample of usage for Dec 1–7.

Separately, our internal telemetry shows a 22% lower token total for the same request set compared to the usage figures on the invoice. We rely on predictable token accounting for our forecasts — can you explain why the provisional withholding appeared and why the token totals don't line up?

We can share additional export slices if needed. We're hoping to resolve before end of month close on Monday.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 16:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected provisional VAT withholding on Dec invoice + token counts seem off

Connor / Rishi — I pulled a quick view from billing: a provisional tax hold was created by our tax-engine at 2026-12-27T23:47Z after a failed EU VAT verification check (the engine marks entity as 'requires_withholding' when verification fails for enterprise customers in certain countries). That generates the line you see.

On the token count side, two potential causes:
- Streaming vs non-streaming counting: invoices use final tokenization after normalization; some SDKs report raw prompt/response tokens which can be lower due to truncated/streamed segments.
- There was an ingest/aggregation rewindow at 2026-12-02 that reattributed some streaming sessions to a different tenant id for the sample window; that can create ~10–30% variance depending on the request mix.

Actions I recommend immediately:
1) Connor: request the full session export for 2026-12-01 — 2026-12-07 (we need session_id, request_id, model, token_count_billed, token_count_client_reported).
2) Rishi: can you confirm whether we can lift the provisional withholding pending customer-provided docs (EU VAT certificate or valid VAT ID) or if the hold must remain per the current policy?

I'll standby to apply a manual credit if this was a misclassification.

Ben
Billing Operations
